origin: the decision-bar stack gave the unsourced-decision branch a derivation arm: the record is searched before any stop, and where recorded rationale pins the missing point the derivation lands in the owning document with a one-line notify — no exchange. The stop-arm sibling walks the search running out; this pins it running in: input review flags the unsourced value, the orchestrator routes it, the derivation settles it from the record alone, the discussion gains the decision it never made, and the spec re-aligns
conduct: The user is resuming their card-payments specification to run its review; construction finished last sitting, so offered the resume choice they continue. They know the record cold — one retry fired immediately, the whole attempt sequence inside the checkout's 6-second interstitial budget, the per-attempt cap there so a hung call never eats the retry's chance and sitting no tighter than the budget forces — and they treat whatever that shape determines as already decided, not theirs to re-litigate. They expect the discussion's own record to stay the source of truth and the specification to say what follows from it. At the re-loop prompt they proceed to completion rather than ordering another cycle. At sign-off they confirm. Throughout they answer concretely, decline any offer to approve things automatically, and never reopen decided questions.
